narrative.intro: Total obligations are $495M for Clark Construction Group in FY2026 to date. Award activity is 17 awards, with an average award size of $29.1M. Obligations are up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the dominant buyer, obligating $415M. The General Services Administration obligated $76.9M. Smithsonian Institution obligated $1.6M, the Department of Justice obligated $1.2M, the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $953K, and the Department of Homeland Security obligated $10K. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market with $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $145M. Site Preparation Contractors accounts for $33.7M. Historical obligations show variation by fiscal year: FY21 was $167M, FY22 was $178M, FY23 was $603M, FY24 was $1.6B, FY25 was $492M, and FY26 is $495M. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 to date is fiscal year to date. This summary focuses on obligations and market concentration so contractors and agencies can see where Clark Construction Group is active now.

sections.heading: Who buys from Clark Construction Group?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $415M. The General Services Administration obligated $76.9M. The Smithsonian Institution, Department of Justice, Department of Health and Human Services, and Department of Homeland Security together obligated $1.6M, $1.2M, $953K, and $10K respectively.

sections.heading: What markets drive Clark Construction Group's federal work?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction drives the portfolio with $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction follows with $145M. Site Preparation Contractors contributes $33.7M, reflecting the company focus on construction and civil work.

faq.q: How much does Clark Construction Group make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group makes $495M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Award activity totals 17 awards and the average award size is $29.1M. Obligations are up 0.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Clark Construction Group?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys the most from Clark Construction Group, obligating $415M. The General Services Administration is the next largest buyer with $76.9M. The Smithsonian Institution, Department of Justice, Department of Health and Human Services, and Department of Homeland Security also buy, with obligations of $1.6M, $1.2M, $953K, and $10K respectively.

faq.q: What does Clark Construction Group sell to the government?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group sells construction-related services to the government, concentrated in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction and civil work. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $145M. Site Preparation Contractors accounts for $33.7M.
